2609.06737.title: Monte Carlo-Based Ex-Ante Assessment of the Green Benefits of an AI-Driven Smart Agriculture Platform in Hainan
2609.06737.paper_summary: Smart agriculture platforms are widely regarded as key carriers for implementing China's pesticide and fertilizer reduction, water-saving and carbon-reduction agendas, yet a unified quantitative framework for assessing their green value is still lacking. Taking an AI-driven decision platform for tropical agriculture as the object (integrating large-language-model question answering, multimodal pest diagnosis, IoT sensing, satellite remote sensing, and a closed-loop field record system), this study builds a cradle-to-farm-gate agricultural carbon accounting model covering pesticide and fertilizer production, field N2O, irrigation electricity and paddy CH4, translates platform interventions into quantifiable transmission parameters, and propagates parameter uncertainty by Monte Carlo simulation over three Hainan scenarios (mango, winter vegetable, rice/nanfan, area-weighted 40%:30%:30%). Under full adoption, median reductions are 23.5% (90% interval 15.0%-33.2%) for pesticide use, 21.0% (13.8%-28.9%) for fertilizer, 16.5% (10.9%-23.5%) for irrigation water, and 21.5% (16.1%-27.2%) for carbon intensity. Attainment probabilities are high for fertilizer reduction >=15% (90.6%) and clear carbon decline (98.1%), but only about 20% for aggregate water saving >=20%, favoring scenario-specific statements. Sobol first-order indices show soil-test recommendation and organic substitution jointly explain about 83% of the variance of aggregate carbon-intensity reduction. Convergence tests show 10,000 iterations stabilize all statistics; conservative/baseline/optimistic scenario bounds are reported. The framework offers a reproducible, calibration-ready methodology for ex-ante green-value assessment and pilot observation design.
2609.06737.paper_summary_zh: 智慧農業平台被廣泛視為實施中國農藥和化肥減少、水資源節約及碳減排議程的關鍵載體，但目前仍缺乏統一的定量框架來評估其綠色價值。本研究以一個針對熱帶農業的AI驅動決策平台為對象（整合大型語言模型問答、多模態病蟲害診斷、物聯網感知、衛星遙感及封閉循環田間記錄系統），建立了一個涵蓋農藥和化肥生產、田間N2O、灌溉電力及稻田CH4的從搖籃到農場門口的農業碳核算模型，將平台干預轉化為可量化的傳輸參數，並通過蒙特卡洛模擬在三個海南場景下（芒果、冬季蔬菜、稻米/南繁，面積加權40%:30%:30%）傳播參數不確定性。在全面採用的情況下，農藥使用的中位數減少為23.5%（90%區間15.0%-33.2%），化肥為21.0%（13.8%-28.9%），灌溉水為16.5%（10.9%-23.5%），碳強度為21.5%（16.1%-27.2%）。化肥減少>=15%（90.6%）和明顯的碳減少（98.1%）的達成概率較高，但對於總水資源節約>=20%僅約20%，更傾向於場景特定的陳述。Sobol一階指數顯示，土壤測試建議和有機替代共同解釋了約83%的總碳強度減少的變異性。收斂測試顯示10,000次迭代穩定所有統計數據；報告保守/基線/樂觀場景邊界。該框架提供了一種可重複的、準備校準的方法論，用於事前綠色價值評估和試點觀察設計。
